name: Mediterranean Egg Scramble with Zucchini, Bell Pepper, Olives & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop olives and sun-dried tomatoes. Place both in a small bowl and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
12 sun-dried tomatoes, oil-packed

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and small dice zucchini. Place in a medium bowl.
Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; small dice. Add to the bowl with the zucchini.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, peel and mince shallots. Add to the bowl with the veggies.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
Meanwhile, crack eggs into the reserved bowl, then season with spices. Whisk until smooth.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 eggs
¾ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the veggies are soft, pour the egg mixture into the skillet and scramble using a combination of stirring and flipping, making sure to bring in all the mixture from the edges of the pan. Cook until the eggs are no longer runny.
Remove skillet from heat, add olives and sun-dried tomatoes, then gently stir to combine the scramble.
To serve, divide scramble between plates or bowls and top with feta. Enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese
